name: compact-tier
description: §11.5 — the layout for a 21-byte compact tier (tier code 4). Measured at tier 0 with raw layout overrides, the same way §7.6 measured it, so the layout is decided before a tier code is spent on it. Every arm is exactly 21 bytes (161-168 bits: 54 prefix + L·lb + 2·C·cb). Incumbent is the shipped tier-0 shape resized to 21 B, which is what §7.6/§8.6 compare ThumbHash against. The encoder stack (scale_fit=2, ac_nearest, aniso, sel_hv) is the shipped default and needs no override.
